name: thinking-break-cursor
description: Play a fast browser FPS while Cursor's agent is working — it resumes when the agent goes busy and pauses when it finishes.

commands.title: Thinking Break: Install Cursor's agent Hooks

thinkingBreakCursor.gameUrl.description: URL of the Thinking Break game to open.

thinkingBreakCursor.delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after Cursor starts working before opening or resuming the game.

thinkingBreakCursor.idleGraceSeconds.description: Ignore an idle signal that arrives this soon after a busy one, so the game does not pause between consecutive tool calls.

enumDescriptions: Pause the game, save the session, and reopen whichever side bars were closed to make room for it — so you land back on the conversation, not a blank editor. (Panel stays open so the next task resumes instantly.)
Pause the game and leave focus where it is.
Pause the game and close the panel. The next task reopens it from the saved session.
thinkingBreakCursor.onIdle.description: What to do when Cursor finishes a task.

thinkingBreakCursor.hidePanelsWhenPlayin.description: Collapse sidebars when opening the game so the viewport is landscape.

thinkingBreakCursor.openInBackground.description: Open the game panel without stealing focus from the editor.

thinkingBreakCursor.openInExternalBrowse.description: Open the game in your system browser instead of inside Cursor.

thinkingBreakCursor.useSimpleBrowser.description: Use the built-in Simple Browser instead of the Thinking Break webview panel. Pause and resume then require a page reload.

thinkingBreakCursor.roomCode.patternErrorMessage: A room code is 4-12 letters or numbers, or empty for single-player.
thinkingBreakCursor.roomCode.markdownDescription: Shared team room code. When set, the game joins that room automatically every time the panel opens, so teammates see each other with nothing to type. Put it in workspace or organisation settings to enrol a whole team at once. Leave empty for single-player. Requires multiplayer to be configured — see [docs/MULTIPLAYER.md](https://github.com/Doringber/thinkingbreak/blob/main/docs/MULTIPLAYER.md).
